title: Enable case-insensitive mode on ext4
summary: Enable the casefold feature to allow case-insensitive directory operations, useful for Wine and some games.
prerequisites: Identify the device path of the ext4 filesystem
Ensure the partition is not the /boot partition used by GRUB

steps.explain: Enable the casefold feature on the filesystem.
Enable the case-insensitive attribute on a specific empty directory.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the empty directory to make case-insensitive

rollback.explain: Disabling casefold is not reliably supported by tune2fs due to potential bugs. It is recommended to back up data and reformat if you need to remove this feature.

warnings: GRUB does not support casefold. Enabling it on /boot will make the system unbootable.
Casefold is incompatible with overlayfs, which may break Docker or Podman.
The directory must be empty when applying the attribute.
This feature cannot be reliably turned off once enabled.
